name: Custom Shape Glass Suncatcher for Window Hanging
description:
KEY FEATURES

Bring warmth, color, and personality into any space with this Custom Shape Glass Suncatcher. Crafted from premium textured glass with vibrant UV-printed artwork, this decorative piece beautifully catches sunlight to create a charming stained-glass effect. Perfect for windows, walls, or special display areas, it adds an elegant and meaningful touch to any home décor.

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality frosted textured glass with a thickness of 4mm.
    - Features raised glossy lines for a dimensional stained-glass appearance.
    - Includes durable accessories: metal hanging chain, suction cup hook, and metal jump ring for easy installation.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
    4 x 4 inches (10.16 x 10.16 cm) – Hanging chain: 20 cm
    6 x 6 inches (15.24 x 15.24 cm) – Hanging chain: 30 cm
    8 x 8 inches (20.32 x 20.32 cm) – Hanging chain: 30 cm
    10 x 10 inches (25.4 x 25.4 cm) – Hanging chain: 40 cm
    12 x 8.5 inches (30.48 x 21.59 cm) – Hanging chain: 40 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vivid, sharp, and long-lasting designs.
    - High-definition artwork with excellent color accuracy and fade resistance.
    - Please Note: Single-sided printing only. Raised texture printing on the flat surface if included in the customer’s artwork file.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Wipe gently with a soft, dry, or slightly damp cloth.
    - Avoid dropping or strong impacts to prevent breakage.
    - Do not use abrasive cleaners or rough materials.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative window hanging that reflects sunlight beautifully.
    - Creates colorful light effects and enhances room ambiance.
    - Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, offices, patios, and garden spaces.
    - Personalized memorial gift, pet tribute, family keepsake, or decorative art piece.
    - Adds artistic elegance and emotional meaning to any indoor or outdoor setting.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and meaningful gift for everyone on special occasions such as Birthdays, Christmas, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Anniversaries, Weddings, Housewarming, Memorials, and Holidays.
    - Perfect for home décor, office decoration, memorial displays, or seasonal accents, this suncatcher is a timeless gift that brings light, warmth, and sentimental value into everyday life.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Glass Suncatcher for Window Hanging

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.2-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
